articles.title: Understanding the organization and its context
articles.requirement: Determine external and internal issues relevant to the AI management system purpose and strategic direction

articles.title: Understanding stakeholder needs
articles.requirement: Determine interested parties relevant to the AIMS, their requirements, and which are addressed through the management system

articles.title: Scope of the AIMS
articles.requirement: Define the boundaries and applicability of the AI management system — considering internal/external issues and stakeholder requirements

articles.title: AI management system establishment
articles.requirement: Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve an AI management system in accordance with ISO 42001 requirements

articles.title: Leadership and commitment
articles.requirement: Top management shall demonstrate leadership — establish AI policy, ensure integration with business processes, promote improvement

articles.title: AI policy
articles.requirement: Establish an AI policy that includes commitment to responsible AI, sets objectives, and is communicated to all relevant parties

articles.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
articles.requirement: Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities for the AIMS — AI system owners, risk owners, compliance roles

articles.title: AI risk assessment process
articles.requirement: Plan actions to address risks and opportunities — establish AI risk assessment process considering AI-specific risk sources

articles.title: AI risk treatment
articles.requirement: Define and apply an AI risk treatment process — select options, determine controls, produce risk treatment plan

articles.title: AI objectives and planning
articles.requirement: Establish measurable AI objectives at relevant functions and levels — what, resources, responsible, timeline, evaluation

articles.title: Resources for AIMS
articles.requirement: Determine and provide resources needed for establishment, implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the AIMS

articles.title: Competence
articles.requirement: Determine necessary competence of persons doing work affecting AI system performance — ensure competence through education, training, experience

articles.title: Awareness
articles.requirement: Persons working under the organization's control shall be aware of the AI policy, their contribution, and implications of non-conformity

articles.title: Communication
articles.requirement: Determine internal and external communications relevant to the AIMS — what, when, with whom, how, and who communicates

articles.title: Documented information
articles.requirement: AIMS shall include documented information required by ISO 42001 and determined necessary — creation, control, retention

articles.title: Operational planning and control
articles.requirement: Plan, implement, and control processes needed to meet AIMS requirements — criteria for processes, control according to criteria

articles.title: AI risk assessment execution
articles.requirement: Perform AI risk assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes occur — retain documented results

articles.title: AI risk treatment execution
articles.requirement: Implement the AI risk treatment plan and retain documented information on results of risk treatment

articles.title: AI system impact assessment
articles.requirement: Conduct AI system impact assessments for AI systems — assess impacts on individuals, groups, and society before deployment

articles.title: Policies for responsible AI
articles.requirement: Define and maintain policies that address responsible use of AI — fairness, transparency, accountability, safety, privacy

articles.title: Internal organization for AI
articles.requirement: Establish roles, responsibilities, and organizational structure for AI governance — AI ethics board, oversight committees

articles.title: Resources for AI systems
articles.requirement: Determine and provide computational, data, and human resources for AI system development, operation, and maintenance

articles.title: AI system impact assessment controls
articles.requirement: Conduct and document impact assessments throughout the AI system lifecycle — human rights, environmental, societal impacts

articles.title: AI system lifecycle
articles.requirement: Manage AI systems through their lifecycle — design, development, testing, deployment, operation, monitoring, retirement

articles.title: Data for AI systems
articles.requirement: Manage data quality, provenance, and integrity for AI systems — data collection, preparation, labelling, bias assessment

articles.title: AI system transparency and explainability
articles.requirement: Ensure AI systems are transparent and explainable to relevant stakeholders — document capabilities, limitations, decision logic

articles.title: AI system performance and monitoring
articles.requirement: Monitor AI system performance — accuracy, reliability, fairness metrics, drift detection, feedback mechanisms

articles.title: Third-party and supply chain management
articles.requirement: Manage AI-related risks from third parties and supply chain — vendor assessment, contractual requirements, monitoring

articles.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation
articles.requirement: Determine what needs monitoring and measuring for the AIMS — methods, when, who analyses, and when results reported

articles.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
articles.requirement: When nonconformity occurs — react, evaluate, implement corrective action, review effectiveness, update risks if needed
